title: BluForge Assist: Retainer-Based Incident Response Service | Quadra
description: BluForge Assist gives enterprises on-demand, retainer-based incident response expertise — with Quadra's security team ready to contain, investigate, and recover from breaches at a moment's notice.

blocks.text: BluForge Assist™ is our retainer-based incident response service. In the event of a major breach, time is your most critical asset. This service provides you with priority, SLA-backed access to our top incident response experts
A Major Incident is Not the Time to be Exchanging Business Cards

When a critical breach occurs, every second counts. The chaos of finding, vetting, and onboarding an incident response firm while the attack is ongoing can lead to devastating financial and reputational damage
Our blueprint is to establish a trusted partnership before a crisis hits
We onboard your organization into our systems ahead of time, understanding your environment and establishing secure communication channels
When an incident is declared, our expert team is activated within a guaranteed SLA, ready to act immediately
We manage the entire incident lifecycle, from containment and remediation to root cause analysis and delivering executive reports with key learnings to strengthen your future defenses.
Legal & Compliance Support with 24x7 Activation Availability
